name: Jupiter & Mars: Definitive Edition
storyline: In a future Earth transformed by climate change, rising seas have submerged coastal cities and humanity has disappeared. As the oceans begin to reclaim the world, the remnants of human civilization still threaten marine life. An ancient race of whales known as the Elders enlists two dolphins, Jupiter and Mars, to journey across the oceans and shut down a global network of abandoned machines disrupting the underwater ecosystem. Along the way, Jupiter and Mars explore the ruins of the old world, rescue sea creatures, and work together to restore life to the oceans.
summary: Jupiter & Mars: Definitive Edition is a newly reimagined version of the acclaimed underwater adventure for Nintendo Switch, featuring a new third-person perspective, enhanced visuals, new music, improved navigation and other enhancements.
